title: Platform Capability Registry
description: Declarative source of truth for what each host platform (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, VS Code, Copilot) can do. Consumed by the sync and init code so per-host behavior is declared data, not inline branches. See docs/adr/0033-platform-capability-registry.md.

displayName.description: Human-facing host name as reported by host-capabilities detection; also the key in the displayName-to-id lookup.

hasNativeSubagents.description: True when the host routes subagents itself (OpenCode, Cursor, VS Code). When true, the static specialist roster is NOT injected into the system prompt; the host resolves the chain at runtime via orchestration_policy.

instructionsOnly.description: True when the host accepts only instruction text (no agents, no MCP) — Copilot.

supportsMcp.description: True when the host can register MCP servers.

configFormat.description: Native config serialization for the host.

localModelProvisioning.description: How the host provisions local-model context windows. 'modelfile' = Ollama Modelfile variants (OpenCode). 'none' = not applicable.

supported.description: True when the host runs lifecycle hooks (Claude Code only today).

globalAllowlist.description: Hook group ids permitted at user/global scope (safety-only subset). Empty unless hooks.supported is true.

globalMcpAllowlist.description: MCP server ids permitted at user/global scope. Empty unless the host supports MCP at global scope.
